description: Resume collection for a paused item. The result's collection field says what will collect it: monitor, prepaid or subscription (collected from the next scheduled run), manual (only on request), or needs_schedule_approval (resumed, but prepaid collection needs a standing approval in Workspace funds before anything runs; tell the user, do not report it as collecting). Items whose platform cannot collect in their region (TikTok in CN or HK) stay paused and return UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM_REGION; report that reason rather than retrying. Changes only the requested workspace state. Backend authorization, validation and any quote/approval, budget and idempotency controls remain authoritative; tool selection does not authorize additional work.
